alert.fp_fn: section 4's definition; the model's row is at P = 0.5, also 0.2 and 0.33
alert.model: P(final >= tau) at or above alert probability

bar.headline: bar met only if all three lines are met; each is reported separately

net_benefit.else: section 8, failure 4: recommend the factor, say what the model added and what it costs
net_benefit.line: P(NB model > NB factor) at least 0.9 in the bootstrap counts as a win, on all state-days in the clusters, at pt 0.2, 0.33, 0.5 for tau 3, 6, 9. Model beats factor if it wins at least 2 of 3 pt on at least 2 of 3 tau; the same test with recalibrated P from 2021-12-17 is reported beside it

bar.note: plan section 4: the nowcast has to earn its place through a calibrated probability, a chosen false-alarm rate and state behaviour. If it does not, that is the headline

point.line: model MAE log below factor and below ladder on all state-days

probability.also: raw coverage reported beside it, and 80% against P8's 0.6-0.95
probability.line: on dates from 2021-12-17, recalibrated central 50, 80, 95% coverage each within 0.05 of nominal

crossing.definition: final at or above tau for 3 days after 3 days below; wave by crossing date: Delta to 2021-12-14, BA.1 to 2022-02-28, BA.2 after
crossing.lateness: first day the signal is up from 10 days before the crossing to the end of the window, days after the crossing; none means never. Early alerts censored at -10. This reading reproduces section 4's frozen row exactly (checked on 2026-11-02) and 81 crossings, 37 clusters
crossing.release: alert off after 3 days below, and after 5 days below (Q6), each stated as false-alarm days, late days and number of alert periods

failure_2.appears: hindsight CRPS more than 5% below honest CRPS; within 5% means it did not appear
failure_2.quantity: mean CRPS on incidence over 8 dates x 16 states, variant 2 against variant 1

hard_dates.from_december: so RKI's daily benchmark exists on every one
hard_dates.rule: 2022-01-13 (P4's hard date), then as-of dates from 2021-12-01 ranked by the number of state x tau within 25% of tau on the final series (section 9's definition), ties by date, each at least 10 days from those already picked, until 8. Data only, no model output

hindsight_design.fixed: posterior mean logit hazard per state x row x delay bin from the one finished fit, and the tail ratio of the 28 rows ending on the as-of date read from the finished triangle
hindsight_design.free: level, growth, weekday, overdispersion, as the main model
hindsight_design.note: section 5 prices this as one more 249 s fit. It has 60,768 cells and 1,335 parameters, so it costs more; measured wall is reported

immutable: Not changed after this write. Any later reading is reported as a lapse, never edited in.

machine.thermal_event: Tctl over 90 C, GPU over 92 C, or hw_thermal_slowdown active, 5 s samples, as P5

net_benefit.rki: probability approximated as lognormal from its mean and 95% interval, from December only: labelled
net_benefit.subset: all state-days and days within 25% of tau
net_benefit.uncertainty: Bayesian bootstrap over the 37 state x wave clusters with a crossing, 2,000 draws, seed 90. Point values on all 48 cells also printed

not_in_full: CPU pool: measured in P5, a baseline, not rerun. Notebook, registry, README and site entries: the build

per_fit_lines.finished_fit_quantity: share of cases reported within delay 0-6, mean over rows, per state (frac7); same three lines
per_fit_lines.quantity: latent state 7-day totals, as P4; strata on all-age state totals
per_fit_lines.restart: a fit failing any line restarts once. Both are kept: the failure in failed_runs. A date failing twice keeps the restart, is flagged, listed and stays in the scores

pilot_fits_reused.2021-12-26: p4_gpu_r1226, the restart run in P5 with seed 99. It is the refit section 14 asks for, so no third fit is run. The failed chunk moves to failed_runs

rules: per state x tau: the signal and alert probability with the best net benefit at pt 0.33 among signals in the list, labelled in-sample; with its false-alarm days and median days late

rung.daily_update: dropped: P6 no-go and gap 2 also fails
rung.stage_fits: 16 states, every as-of date 2021-09-15 to 2022-04-29, 227 fits, 32 chains, ChEES, float32, target 0.85, warmup 1000, draws 1000

scores.coverage: central 50, 80, 95% from the stored quantiles, whole window, per state, per wave; 95% also on RKI's interval from December
scores.crps: on incidence per 100,000, sample form, from each fit's stored noisy draws (about 500); point signals score absolute error
scores.mae_log: log posterior median of final incidence against log final, zeros excluded and counted
scores.predictive_check: section 6: cells revealed after the as-of date, without a refit. From each fit's stored draws, rebuild the last 7 rows, draw NegBinomial, compare with the cell 80 days on, for bins unknown on the as-of date. Central 80% coverage per cell

recalibration.allowed: as-of dates with truth known by then: at least 80 days before the date being recalibrated, section 6
recalibration.no_tuning: one method, set here, whatever it does
recalibration.rule: k(a) = 0.8 empirical quantile, over state-dates at least 80 days before a, of |log(final/median)| / half-width, half-width = (log q90 - log q10)/2. k floored at 1. Each draw x becomes median * (x/median)^k. One k per date across states
recalibration.starts: first date with at least 14 earlier dates: 2021-12-17. Before it the raw draws stand and scores name both spans

scores.state_days: 227 as-of dates x 16 states = 3,632, Destatis populations

seeds.note: fixed by date; none is chosen by a result
seeds.stage: chunk id (days since 2021-09-15) + 11, the pilots' rule

source: plans/large/E90.md sections 4, 6, 8, 9, 11, 14; gates_2026-11-02.json stays in force for what it defines
store: Store.verify finds no problems at the end
strata_question: how many of 8 x 16 x 3 alerts at P = 0.5 change against the state model on the same date; largest change in P(cross); CRPS on the 8 dates
written_before: any FULL fit ran. The 23 pilot dates had been seen, including all_scores.json. Nothing here was set from a FULL result.
